build_notes.gear: Mostly SS DPS gear. Weapon, necklace, and gloves are the high-forged damage core. Chest, belt, and boots are lower-forged.
build_notes.tech: Active high-impact techs include Lightning Mode, Laser Mode, Drone Mode, Rocket Mode, plus Molotov/Soccer modes. The old Soccer +3.82 reading was a SIO swap/toggle signal, not a spending target.
build_notes.pet: Nutjob/Xeno setup with 85% sync. Spend awakening only on a completed star/stat breakpoint.

quick_answer: Do NOT spend tech choices on Soccer. First spend into SS Belt forge if the forge screen lets you complete the step. Use relic core chests and exact core-choice chests only for that Belt step. Then use tech core choice chests on Lightning Mode first, Laser Mode second. Use awakening crystals only if Nutjob/Xeno reaches the next star now. Save S-grade packs unless they are exact SS forge fodder.

direct_spend_plan.title: SS Belt forge is the first real spend target
direct_spend_plan.status: SPEND NOW IF THE STEP COMPLETES
resource_to_use: core_choice_chest x6 only for exact missing core type
eternal_cores x20 / chaos_cores x10 only if the Belt step asks
direct_spend_plan.target: Open Equipment -> SS Belt -> forge screen. Try to complete the next Belt forge breakpoint. Open only the exact selectors required by that screen.
direct_spend_plan.why: Your damage-core gear slots already look stronger than the lower SS slots. Belt is the best lower-forged DPS slot to push before chest. This is more important than forcing random tech or pet partial progress.
direct_spend_plan.exact_choice_rule: If the Belt step asks for Void cores, pick Void cores from core choice chests. If it asks Eternal, pick Eternal. If it asks Chaos, pick Chaos. Do not pre-open all 6 core selectors.
direct_spend_plan.stop_condition: If SS Belt cannot complete a breakpoint with your current cores/selectors, check SS Boots next. If Boots cannot complete, check SS Chest. If none complete, save all unopened selectors.

direct_spend_plan.title: Tech core choice chests go to Lightning Mode, not Soccer
direct_spend_plan.target: Choose Lightning Mode tech cores first. If Lightning cannot take them or does not hit a breakpoint, choose Laser Mode next. After that: Drone Mode, then Rocket Mode.
direct_spend_plan.why: I previously mixed this up. Soccer +3.82% was not a material-spending instruction. Your active SIO tech impact shows Lightning and Laser are huge damage pieces, and Lightning is behind Laser, so Lightning is the better first tech-core target.
direct_spend_plan.exact_choice_rule: Priority order for the 40 chests: Lightning Mode -> Laser Mode -> Drone Mode -> Rocket Mode. Do not spend them on Soccer unless SIO after rerun explicitly ranks Soccer as the best active tech investment.
direct_spend_plan.stop_condition: Spend to the next visible resonance/breakpoint, rerun SIO, then continue only if Lightning/Laser still rank as the best damage gain.

direct_spend_plan.title: Use S-grade packs only as exact SS forge fodder
direct_spend_plan.target: Only open these when SS Belt/Boots/Chest forge needs a specific faction/core source you do not have.
direct_spend_plan.why: These packs are flexible value. Opening them randomly can create the wrong faction/core and does not guarantee a damage breakpoint.
direct_spend_plan.exact_choice_rule: If the forge step lacks Void cores, use the Voidwalker crate/choose Voidwalker fodder. If it lacks Eternal or Chaos, choose that exact faction instead.
direct_spend_plan.stop_condition: If opening the pack does not finish the forge step immediately, keep the pack closed.

direct_spend_plan.title: Awakening crystals only go into Nutjob/Xeno if next star finishes now
direct_spend_plan.why: Your pet build is Nutjob/Xeno based, but partial awakening progress is weaker than completed SS/tech breakpoints.
direct_spend_plan.exact_choice_rule: If 22 crystals unlock the next Nutjob/Xeno star now, spend them. If they only fill progress, save them.
direct_spend_plan.stop_condition: Do not spend gems on normal pet chests for this unless the event gives guaranteed Xeno crystals at better value than relic/tech selectors.

direct_spend_plan.title: Gems are for guaranteed breakpoint materials only
direct_spend_plan.target: Buy relic cores, exact core selectors, tech core selectors, Xeno crystals, or guaranteed S/SS selectors.
direct_spend_plan.why: At your stage, random chests are usually worse than guaranteed materials that complete SS Belt, Lightning/Laser tech, or Nutjob/Xeno breakpoints.
direct_spend_plan.exact_choice_rule: Do not use gems on normal pet chest spam unless the event math guarantees more Xeno progress than direct selectors/relic cores.
direct_spend_plan.stop_condition: If the event shop does not sell top-3 breakpoint materials at good value, save gems.
